description: This PHP class, CalendarSyncOperationSerializer, handles serialization and deserialization of CalendarSyncOperation objects for Calendar synchronization processes in a SuiteCRM context. It converts objects to JSON strings and vice versa, with validation and handling of related entities like CalendarLocation and CalendarSyncAction.

classes.name: CalendarSyncOperationSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for CalendarSyncOperation objects, providing methods to serialize to and deserialize from JSON.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a CalendarSyncOperation object into a JSON string, including its attributes and optionally serializing its payload event.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to reconstruct a CalendarSyncOperation object, validating fields and converting string values to enum instances.
